532:t_2:27.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Which bastard went and planted such a pain in the neck in us, anyway!?」

532:t_2:30.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I only have a vague image of it inside me too. But if I were to put it into words...」

532:t_2:34.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This experiment is also meant to confirm that.」

532:t_2:35.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We are about to touch the $$集合無意識$$ that lies beyond this door.」

532:t_2:36.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Hold it right there! What the heck is this $$集合無意識$$ thing!?」

532:t_2:37.en:
$n
「In psychology, it's a collective of consciousness beyond the individual, lying even deeper than the human unconscious, but...」

532:t_2:38.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's right. It can be called the common consciousness shared by all of humanity.」

532:t_2:39.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And it is also called the 《$$アカシックレコード$$》.」

532:t_2:40.en:
$n
「The past and future of all events... In other words, the sum of all knowledge?」

532:t_2:41.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Isn't it just a concept, not something that actually exists?」

532:t_2:42.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「At least beyond this door, it exists as an entity.」

532:t_2:43.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It is the very natural order of the world, a being that transcends life and death, time and space.」

532:t_2:45.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The power of the $$源理$$... In other words, $$次元力$$?」

532:t_2:46.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「As you pointed out, I believe the existence of the $$集合無意識$$ is also connected to the control of $$次元力$$.」

532:t_2:47.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Why do you know of the existence of such a thing?」

532:t_2:48.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I don't know either since when, or for what purpose, this has existed...」

532:t_2:49.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But that materialized $$集合無意識$$ is the very source of the power of $$ギアス$$, and what the $$ギアス嚮団$$ has been guarding.」

532:t_2:51.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「During the $$再世戦争$$, in my fight against $$シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア$$, I touched a part of it.」

532:t_2:52.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「My anxiety that the image I sensed there is gradually becoming reality...」

532:t_2:53.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I overlay onto that the existence of the one who carved the $$烙印$$... in other words, God.」

532:t_2:54.en:
$n
(So $$ゼロ$$ has been feeling the same kind of unease as me, $$クロウ$$, and Miss $$スズネ$$...?)

532:t_2:55.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「To confirm that, all of $c, who likewise bear the $$烙印$$, will attempt to make contact with the $$集合無意識$$.」

532:t_2:56.en:
???
「As expected of you, $$ゼロ$$. You are a capable successor.」

532:t_2:58.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「If it were you, you could have upheld its doctrine far more correctly than the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives.」

532:t_2:60.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Is it wise to be distracted by me?」

532:t_2:63.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You stopped my knife-hand strike with a single knife, $$クロウ・ブルースト$$?」

532:t_2:64.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That was close. If our Reactors hadn't sensed each other, I might really have let $$ゼロ$$ get taken out.」

532:t_2:66.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「$$ゼロ$$ can wait. I'll take him first.」

532:t_2:67.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$沈黙の巨蟹$$... You come at me?」

532:t_2:68.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You're the one who wiped out the troops stationed here, aren't you.」

532:t_2:69.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Correct. I had to remove those who stood in their way.」

532:t_2:71.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I am the last one.」

532:t_2:74.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Well then, shall we begin?」

532:t_2:79.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Collective unconscious! Show us the truth, now!!」

532:t_2:84.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「...The power of the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$... no, of $$鬼宿$$, seems to have interfered.」

532:t_2:85.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Because of it, they will end up sensing those who have already lost their bodies.」

532:t_2:87.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Just as expected of you, $$熱気バサラ$$... You do hold the exact opposite power to $$尸空#pilot$$ of $$鬼宿$$.」

532:t_2:88.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Like I give a damn about that!」

532:t_2:90.en:
$$バサラ$$
「$$ゼロ$$ told us to go meet the collective unconscious! Then I'm doing it my way!」

532:t_2:91.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Here I come, collective unconscious! Listen to my soooong!!」

532:t_2:95.en:
$$アルト$$
「Stop, $$ランカ$$! Your song isn't meant to be used for something like that!」

532:t_2:96.en:
$$アルト$$
「Hate me if you want! But!」

532:t_2:97.en:
$$アルト$$
「Just protect the song you loved!!」

532:t_2:103.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Lend me your hand once more.」

532:t_2:105.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Why? If someone doesn't manage humanity, all that awaits is despair.」

532:t_2:106.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「The $$人類銀河同盟$$ knew that. That's why they built a society like that.」

532:t_2:108.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「So, $$レド$$... Lend your hand to me... to $$ストライカー#robot$$.」

532:t_2:109.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「To protect the people dear to you, too, create a god to lead humanity.」

532:t_2:116.en:
$$宗介$$
「Answer me, $$千鳥$$! I'm right here by your side!」

532:t_2:117.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I can't, $$宗介$$... Right now, I'm me, but I'm not me.)
